kitDescription: Yulha is a Fire sniper-rifle Burst-III attacker whose defining mechanic is the 'Calm' self-status, earned by being attacked 30 times. While Calm is active her own critical rate rises by 24.53% for 20 seconds, and her burst — which normally hits all enemies for 457.87% of final ATK — fires a second identical 457.87% hit, effectively doubling. Her Skill 2 periodically grants all allies (including herself) a large 90.75% ATK buff for 5 seconds and lets the squad equally share incoming damage for 10 seconds. In the scope-lock sim the boss never attacks, so Calm can never be earned: only the team ATK buff and the single-hit burst fire, with the Calm-gated half of the kit honestly documented as out-of-domain.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA found. All six kit lines are FAITHFUL (S2 ATK buff, burst base nuke) or DOCUMENTED_GAP with verbatim unmodeled records plus ⚑ estimate/recipe (S1 Calm trigger + crit, S2 damage-share, burst Calm rider). The blind convergence is strong and cross-family: S5 (opus) runs 21 passed / 1 legit skipped / 0 failed UNMODIFIED against the shipped override, and S2b (fable) independently derived the identical per-line dispositions including the same nearest-wrong counterfactuals the driver's spec pins. S6 (opus) is the sole outlier on three gated calls, and on each the driver is corroborated by the other two agents and by the MEASURED>FUDGE rule: interval:30 is datamined where S6's interval:20 is invented (and matches neither the skill CD nor her 40s burst CD); zero Calm crit is the faithful default where S6's interval:12 is an unmeasured cadence; a single 457.87% burst is the faithful default where S6's ungated doubling is the exact nearest-wrong model S2b named and S5 discriminates against, self-admitted as over-crediting. Discrimination holds: every load-bearing assertion fails under its named counterfactual (selfOnly, weakS2, longS2, fastS2, noS2, weakBurst, burstOnFbEnter, calmAlways), and the fire-rate check passes — the S2 buff demonstrably fires at t=30/60/90/120/150 and the burst casts ≥2× with FB-exempt, core-free, range-free hits. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: S5 and S6 share the opus family, so the driver's true cross-family corroboration rests on S2b alone; the honest ⚑ exposure the owner should sanity-check is that the shipped board reading reflects HALF Yulha's theoretical Calm-active burst and no Calm crit — the meta-defining lever on her real DPS — gated on a measured Calm-uptime recipe (boss attack cadence vs the squad, noting the S2 damage-share raises her incoming-hit share in-game, so a solo-derived cadence would under-count). The datamined skill2 CD of 30s driving the interval cadence and the SR charge/reload tuple remain standing measurement-gated ⚑ items, out of magnitude scope.
